provider.reason: Owner must select an existing subscription route and approve data recipients; candidates are not verified capabilities.

exact_model_snapshot.reason: Capture the selected interface's returned model identifier and immutable snapshot if supported; loop aliases alone do not pin snapshots.

snapshot_pinning_limitations_and_run_win.reason: Verify snapshot support and record alias drift limits plus an owner-approved bounded UTC run window before freezing the manifest.

model_image_capabilities.requirement: Both arms must accept identical native panel/diagram images where available. Verify selected interface image limits with public development inputs; record unavailable images and unsupported modalities explicitly.

independent_repetitions_per_case_arm.pairing: Same case/key and repetition ID in both arms; each arm uses a fresh isolated session. Counts apply equally to each case and arm. Pilot count is a design allocation, not executed evidence.

manifest_fields.sampling_order: Sort case IDs and repetition IDs; freeze complete order before evaluation. No evaluation-driven reordering or repeat selection.

paired_arm_randomization.method: Sort arms by sha256(seed:pair_id:arm), matching runner-contract.md

manifest_fields.stopping_rule: Execute the frozen planned pairs once; no optional stopping on observed gains. Quota exhaustion stops dispatch, preserves all outcomes and marks the comparison incomplete; no selective replacement of failed pairs.

affordable_run_ceiling.reason: Owner quota allocation and development resource estimates are missing. Include pilot, evaluation, separate probes, retries and operational reserve; never authorize extra spending.

manifest_fields.precision_cost_plan_revision: benchmark/precision/plan.json design v1; freeze content SHA256 and independent review/owner acceptance records after development pilots, before evaluation

per_case_tolerances_and_nondeterminism.rule: Freeze numerical units, comparison tolerances and allowed nondeterminism per case and dimension before exposure; precision settings do not supply oracle tolerances.

uncertainty_procedure.fidelity: Report required reader-probe outcomes separately; no-tool is not applicable and no paired fidelity gain is defined.
uncertainty_procedure.estimand: For each dimension separately, case/repetition score is correct required items divided by the frozen required-item denominator; difference is tool minus no-tool. Report full outcome counts, extras and dimension assessments alongside this descriptive score; it is not an overall pass or a substitute for protocol precedence rules.
uncertainty_procedure.aggregation: Average complete repetition differences within case, then equally weight cases within each lineage, then equally weight independent lineages. Recompute within declared coverage strata; never combine dimensions.
uncertainty_procedure.resampling: Sample G lineage IDs with replacement, G draws per replicate; carry each selected lineage's whole project/case/repetition block, preserving paired arms. Recompute the same estimator; take empirical 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles using linear interpolation at (B-1)*p. No resampling of files or repetitions as independent lineages.

resampling_seed_and_count.generator: Python stdlib random.Random; pin Python implementation/version with the future executed analysis

independent_lineage_units_and_repeat_pre.rule: Use accepted lineage allocation, not file hashes alone. Shared dependencies and variants stay in the same group. Groups, not repeated calls, determine independent sample size.

missing_pair_treatment.rule: A pair requires both arms and independently scored fixed inventories; never replace missing arms with zero or a successful repeat. Scored unsupported/error/missing items remain non-correct in fixed denominators, with their explicit outcomes. Missing keys or unscorable arms make a pair incomplete.
missing_pair_treatment.report: Keep all planned cases in coverage and report planned/attempted/executed/scored/complete pairs and reasons by stratum. Any complete-pair-only estimate/interval is explicitly conditional and cannot establish a completed comparison. Show planned-weight lower/upper bounds by assigning each missing paired difference -1/+1 under fixed case/lineage weights; all-missing scope has bounds [-1,1] and no point estimate.

manifest_fields.exclusions_and_aggregation_weights: No result-dependent exclusions. Fixed equal case weights within lineage and equal lineage weights; predeclare stratum membership and planned denominators before evaluation. Conditional complete-pair estimates disclose their changed eligible denominator; planned-weight bounds preserve missing scope.
manifest_fields.small_sample_and_unavailable_scope_repor: Report independent lineage count, repeat counts and unavailable scope per stratum. With fewer than two complete independent lineages, no inferential interval; with small G, label bootstrap intervals unstable and do not claim nominal coverage. Repeats cannot repair missing lineage diversity.

owner_precision_target_and_acceptance_re.reason: Owner must accept per-dimension uncertainty targets, scope, reviewed method and final repetition/cost plan. This design proposes no precision target or quality threshold.

pilot_sizing.prerequisites: Independently checked development cases/keys, accepted lineage groups, reviewed scorer, matched budgets/prompts, tested isolation, verified route and existing quota allocation. No pilot is authorized or executed by this file.
pilot_sizing.variance_model: For each paired dimension and stratum, fit development paired differences with random lineage intercept and independent repeat residual, after fixed within-lineage case averaging. Estimate nonnegative between-lineage variance tau2 and within-lineage repetition variance sigma2; preserve case covariance by averaging the same repetition index across cases. Document estimator, fit diagnostics, counts and sensitivity; inadequate groups or model fit block sizing rather than invent variance.
pilot_sizing.prediction: For G planned independent lineages and candidate r, predicted variance of equal-lineage mean = tau2/G + sigma2/(G*r); predicted 95% half-width = 1.96*sqrt(tau2/G + sigma2/(G*r)). This normal planning approximation is not the final cluster-bootstrap interval or a coverage guarantee; validate sensitivity with development cluster resampling.
pilot_sizing.selection: Once owner targets exist, select the smallest candidate r satisfying every declared paired dimension/stratum target under development-only variance and the verified quota ceiling. If none fits, or the between-lineage floor exceeds a target, report infeasible and request an owner decision on more independent development-supported scope/resources or targets; do not tune against evaluation gains.
pilot_sizing.cost: Planned paired calls = 2 * case_count * r. Add 2 * development_case_count * 4 pilot calls, separately budgeted probes, all attempted/retried calls and reserve. Use conservative development token/time measurements against verified subscription units, renewal window, rate limits and existing remaining quota. Unknown conversion or quota means not affordable yet.
pilot_sizing.freeze: Before any evaluation request, record pilot evidence hashes, variance estimates and diagnostics, G and scope, selected integer r per case/arm, exact model/manifest settings, owner targets/acceptance, uncertainty settings, resource ceiling and stopping rule. A pilot-derived change requires a new reviewed revision; evaluation results cannot influence it.

candidate_routes.evidence: supplied loop routing; startup identifies claude-sonnet-5-5
supplied loop routing candidate; codex is the loop adapter, underlying service/interface must be verified
issue-specified loop routing candidate; availability unverified

quota.capability_status: All candidates require interface-level verification of model identity, image support, fresh-session controls, token accounting, seed/settings support, snapshot pinning and permitted data routing/retention; no capability or quota has been verified here.
quota.owner_decision: Which existing subscription quota should be allocated: name one candidate provider/model route and the underlying account/service/interface (no credentials), authorize the case data recipients/retention, and allocate explicit existing remaining units, renewal/run window, rate limits and a hard total ceiling covering development pilots, paired evaluation, separate probes, retries and reserve. Confirm no extra spending. After measured development costs, accept the affordable repetition plan or leave evaluation blocked.
